newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soyoil weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soyoil weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soyoil weekly export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 30,800 MT were mainly the result of increases for unknown destinations (20,000 MT), Hong Kong (7,000 MT), and the Dominican Republic (5,000 MT) being partially offset by reductions for Mexico (4,900 MT).
Exports of 41,300 MT were to Morocco (14,000 MT), Hong Kong (12,000 MT), China (10,000 MT), Mexico (3,200 MT), and Nicaragua (2,000 MT).
